question: How many systems on the November 2026 TOP500 list will be exascale?

calls.reasoning: June 2026 TOP500 has exactly 5 systems with Rmax >= 1,000 PF (LineShine 2198.4, El Capitan 1809, Frontier 1353, Aurora 1012, JUPITER Booster 1000.00); next is HPC7 at 571.5. Systems stay on the list with their last submitted score, so the count is very unlikely to drop. Since Frontier (Jun 2022), 4 of 8 lists added one new exascale system, 3 of the last 4, so the rate is rising. But no named candidate looks ready for SC26: Alice Recoque's delivery only starts Q4 2026, Doudna is late 2026 delivery, Horizon is ~300 PF and Equinox is far below an exaflop on HPL. A sixth would most likely be a surprise (Chinese, hyperscaler GB200/GB300 run, Solstice). No human prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.

- Oct 8-11 2026 drone strikes on Yandex data centers in Russia (systems of ~12-22 PF): irrelevant to the exascale count.
- Searched without finding: any announced SC26 exascale debut, Chinese follow-on systems, or hyperscaler HPL submission plans.

- Event window: the Nov 2026 list publication; as of 2026-10-13 the list is not yet published.

calls.reasoning: June 2026 TOP500 has exactly 5 systems >=1000 PF (LineShine, El Capitan, Frontier, Aurora, JUPITER at exactly 1000.00, which counts under >=); next is 571.5 PF. Entries persist, so <=4 needs a withdrawal or a lower JUPITER re-run, which is rare. A new exascale system appeared on 4 of the last 5 lists, but those were pre-announced apart from LineShine. No named candidate is ready for SC26 (Alice Recoque installing with users ~end-2027, Doudna delivered late 2026, Horizon ~300 PF). A 6th needs a surprise: an AI/hyperscaler cluster, a Chinese system, or a partial Alice Recoque run. No human prediction market found (none per the runs or the harness's Polymarket/Manifold search).
calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: June 2026 count = 5, JUPITER at exactly 1000.00 counts under >=, the count has never fallen, no SC26 exascale debut is announced, Alice Recoque/Doudna are not ready, and no prediction market exists. The only factual discrepancy is how many past transitions added a system (4/8, 4/9, 5/8); I could not settle it without web access, and it is immaterial because all agree recent increments were mostly pre-announced. The remaining dispute is judgment: how much weight to give an unannounced entry. LineShine shows surprises happen, and large AI clusters could plausibly run HPL above 1 EF, so I put ~30% on 6 or more, at the upper end of the runs.
